title: Security: Family and Media Surge — Reunification and Media Control

lines.text: Security to HCC. About 90 family members and friends are in the Tower B lobby and the ED waiting room, and a Channel 11 truck is at the main entrance. Some families are trying to walk through the ambulance bay. I need a reunification room away from the ED and a decision on who talks to the press.

Copy, Security. The family reunification center is activated in the Tower A lobby. Social Work and Spiritual Care are en route. Security, hold the ambulance bay and the two public entrances. The PIO will manage media outreach. No one speaks to the press except the PIO.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject introduces operational friction from family and media pressure. The AOC must activate the reunification center per the Patient Surge and Evacuation Annex, and the PIO must assume media control to prevent unauthorized disclosures.
